title: Prognosebuch: day-ahead electricity price forecasts for DE-LU with a public, pre-registered track record
description:
Prognosebuch ("forecast ledger") publishes a probabilistic forecast (P10/P50/P90, 15-minute resolution) of German day-ahead electricity prices (bidding zone DE-LU) for D+1 and D+2 every morning, before the auction results are published. Each forecast is committed as an immutable file with a manifest (issue time, data cutoffs, code commit, SHA-256), scored automatically against the real prices and compared with rules of thumb, including missed days and Diebold-Mariano tests.

This record is a weekly snapshot of the repository: forecasts, scores, actual prices, weather inputs, code and documentation. Prices: Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de (CC BY 4.0). Weather: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Data licensed CC BY 4.0, code MIT. Not investment advice, not a trading signal.
